name: Tiko Cards
subtitle: Picture cards that speak
promotional_text: A visual AAC card library for children. Tap a card, hear it spoken. Build vocabulary, one picture at a time.
description:
Tiko Cards is a picture-card communication tool for children and non-verbal users. Tap a card and it speaks — building vocabulary and a voice, one picture at a time.

Organize cards into folders, browse by category, and let children explore language visually. Works offline and opens ready to use.

- Tap any card to hear it spoken aloud
- Browse and organize a personal card library
- No ads, no clutter, no account required to start
- Child mode keeps the focus on communication

Part of Tiko, a child-first universe of small, focused AAC tools.
